Sara — quick technical note from Redwood security:

We’ll require a scoped staging environment for the pen test (no production data), ephemeral service accounts scoped to the API surface under test, and a read-only logging view (CloudWatch/Stackdriver equivalent) for the duration of the window. We recommend the primary window (week of 2026-08-23) and will reserve a small bug-fix slot the following week for high-severity findings.

On evidence buckets: we’ll provide a CSV mapping (attached) that ties SOC 2 criteria to sample artifacts — e.g., user access logs (artifact), change control tickets (process), infra config snapshots (config).

Team — internal legal notes for the thread (posting here so procurement has visibility).

1) MSA/order form: Acme requested the security exhibit as a binding appendix. We should propose language that is measurable ("evidence delivered within 5 business days for requested samples") rather than open-ended.
2) Pen test indemnity / safe harbor: we will not accept broad indemnity; propose a scoped clause that covers agreed test targets and standard rules of engagement.
3) Audit rights: suggest limiting live-production inspection to scheduling notice + scoped sampling; provide SOC 2 reports and rolling evidence packages for most asks.
4) Data handling: confirm that any sampled artifacts with customer data will be redacted (we already provide sanitized exports for evidence).

I’ll draft suggested redlines and share in the playbook doc (drive link). Flagging Karthik to help with the assurance wording and any SOC 2 assertion mapping nuance.

Laura Bennett
Director, Legal — Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Security exhibit and pen test timing — proposed redlines and next steps

Sara / Acme team —

Thanks for the patience while Legal and Security aligned. Attached is a short redline summary and two proposed exhibit clauses: (A) Evidence cadence & delivery SLA; (B) Scoped inspection language for pen tests and sample-based evidence requests. High-level points:
- Evidence SLA: Redwood will deliver requested sample artifacts within 5 business days; a consolidated package for onboarding within 10 business days. Monthly snapshots thereafter.
- Inspection / pen test: Redwood will provide a staging environment. Production inspection limited to documented sampling and by appointment; we will include an agreed ROP (rules of engagement) appendix and a 3-day window to remediate critical issues before public disclosure.
- SOC 2: Redwood will provide the current SOC 2 Type II report on execution of the order and annual thereafter.

If Acme accepts the language we’ll incorporate the exhibit into the draft order form and circulate for signature. Proposed next step: 30-min call on Monday 2026-07-26 to lock windows and sign-off on redlines.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Compliance — Redwood Inference
